<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Tally columns give a dd table spreadsheet-style sums with nothing implicit: a column is marked `in` before it participates, marked columns sum into a footer row, a column marked `total` holds each row's sum, and the grand total is the footer cell of the total column — the intersection of the two axes. The tally is WRITTEN INTO the .dd.json rather than derived at render, because agents read these numbers with `jq` instead of summing rows themselves; a number that is not in the JSON cannot be queried at all. Storing it creates a failure mode nothing else in the repo can see, so `dd validate` recomputes and compares. This plan is RETROACTIVE: the substrate is already built, committed and independently reviewed APPROVE; what remains is documentation, three minor review findings, and two bodies of work each gated on a ruling that is with Jordan.
